paper.title: Algorithm 822: GIZ, HIZ: Two Fortran 77 Routines for the Computation of Complex Scorer Functions
paper.venue: ACM TOMS 28(4), 436-447 (Dec 2002); the ACM article was not read (dl.acm.org refuses automated fetch from this host); the netlib archive was used

field: numerics (special functions: complex Scorer functions HI(z) and GI(z), tested via their addition formulas)
stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 822 netlib shell archive: Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/driver.f SCTEST, port.f, Fortran77/Src/Dp/src.f and src_819.f)

claim.text: max |residual| of the unscaled GI(Z) addition-formula check (IFAC=1, GITEST modulus) printed by SCTEST into Res1, the shipped reference value 9.1704421834038D-14 (artifact-reference), absolute tolerance 1e-12 (fixed in the queue entry before any run).

reference.archive: netlib TOMS 822.gz, sha256 ae6c947ece8fea8ba98d2f10ce44e3370e14af7a9e14a92217dfcfc5a65e8a50, file Fortran77/Drivers/Dp/res1 (copied from the sandbox unpack)

attempt: The archive's Doc/Makefile (epcf90, lists airy.f) cannot run here: epcf90 is absent and airy.f is not in the archive (original-attempt-make.log). The compile and link lines were written by us (gfortran 16, -O2 and -O0) with no source file edited, so the patch is build-only and proved by three manifests (evidence/manifests). The value is the MAXIMUM VALUE OF THE MODULUS OF THE CHECK line of Res1, identical in three builds (two at -O2, one at -O0).

original_attempt.tried: The authors' Doc/Makefile run in the sandbox (make in Fortran77/Drivers/Dp with that Makefile's FC=epcf90 and OBJS)
original_attempt.reason: epcf90 is not installed (make: epcf90: No such file or directory, exit 2); the Makefile also lists airy.f, which the archive does not ship; the archive's file names do not match its own Makefile (src_819.f holds GIZ/HIZ).

build_commands: gfortran -O2 driver.o src.o src819.o port.o -o sctest
gfortran -O0 driver.o src.o src819.o port.o -o sctest
